title: Purine Metabolism: Hyperuricemia and Enzyme Defects
subject: Biochemistry
preview: Purine degradation ultimately produces uric acid in humans, and xanthine oxidase contributes to this pathway.
quickRevision: Purine degradation ultimately produces uric acid in humans, and xanthine oxidase contributes to this pathway.
Adenosine deaminase deficiency is a cause of severe combined immunodeficiency.
Hyperuricemia results from overproduction, underexcretion or both; clinical context determines evaluation.

sections.title: Core biomedical mechanism
points: Purine degradation ultimately produces uric acid in humans, and xanthine oxidase contributes to this pathway.
HGPRT is involved in purine salvage; severe deficiency causes Lesch–Nyhan syndrome.

sections.title: Clinical application
points: Adenosine deaminase deficiency is a cause of severe combined immunodeficiency.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not treat all high urate measurements as synonymous with symptomatic gout.
